_: Descriptions for the fields IGDB's API docs leave empty, by entity, then by field name for every entity ("*"). The docs win when they describe a field.

*.name: The name of the item
*.alpha_channel: True when the image has an alpha channel (transparency)
*.animated: True when the image is animated
*.trusted: IGDB's trusted flag on the link; IGDB does not document what it checks
*.game: The game this row belongs to
*.created_at: Date this was initially added to the IGDB database
*.updated_at: The last date this entry was updated in the IGDB database

AgeRatingContentDescription.description: The content descriptor, as the organization words it

AgeRatingContentDescriptionV2.description: The content descriptor, as the organization words it, such as "Blood and Gore"

Character.games: The games the character appears in

Collection.as_parent_relations: Relations in which this collection is the parent
Collection.as_child_relations: Relations in which this collection is the child

ContentSafetyRatingDimension.content_safety_rating: The content safety rating this dimension belongs to

DateFormat.format: The precision of a date: YYYYMMDD, YYYYMM, YYYY, YYYYQ1 to YYYYQ4 or TBD

GameStatus.status: The status, such as Released, Early Access, Cancelled or Delisted

GameType.type: The type, such as Main Game, DLC, Expansion, Bundle or Remake

InvolvedCompany.developer: True when the company developed the game
InvolvedCompany.publisher: True when the company published the game
InvolvedCompany.porting: True when the company ported the game to another platform
InvolvedCompany.supporting: True when the company helped develop the game

LanguageSupport.language_support_type: What the language covers: Audio, Subtitles or Interface

PlatformVersionCompany.developer: True when the company developed the platform version
PlatformVersionCompany.manufacturer: True when the company manufactured the platform version

PopularityPrimitive.game_id: The id of the game, as a number: not a relation, so it cannot be expanded
PopularityPrimitive.value: The game's value for the metric; each metric has its own scale
PopularityPrimitive.external_popularity_source: Where the metric comes from: IGDB, Steam, Twitch...

PopularityType.external_popularity_source: Where the metric comes from: IGDB, Steam, Twitch...

ReleaseDateRegion.region: The region's slug, such as europe, north_america or worldwide

Search.alternative_name: Every alternative name of the result, joined into one string
Search.company: Never filled: companies are not in the search index
